config.title: A configuration file : .compodocrc, .compodocrc.json, .compodocrc.yaml, .compodocxrc, .compodocxrc.json, .compodocxrc.yaml, or compodoc/compodocx property in package.json

output.title: Where to store the generated documentation

language.title: Language used for the generated documentation (en-US, fr-FR, zh-CN)

assetsFolder.title: External assets folder to copy in generated documentation folder

silent.title: In silent mode, log messages aren't logged in the console

watch.title: Watch source files after serve and force documentation rebuild

files.title: Files provided by external tool, used for coverage test

theme.title: Choose a built-in theme ('default', 'ocean', 'midnight', 'nord', 'rose-pine', 'ember', 'neon', 'brutalist', 'gitbook') or a path to a custom CSS file

hideGenerator.title: Do not print the compodocx link at the bottom of the page

hideDarkModeToggle.title: Do not show dark mode toggle button at the top right position of the page

items.title: Close by default items in the menu values : ['all'] or one of these ['components','directives','entities','classes','injectables','dependency-injection','guards','interfaces','interceptors','pipes','resolvers','utilities','additionalPages','features'] (features applies under menuLayout: 'feature')

templates.title: Path to directory of JavaScript template overrides (see docs/custom-templates.md)

includes.title: Path of external markdown files to include

includesName.title: Name of item menu of externals markdown files

coverageTest.title: Test command of documentation coverage with a threshold (default 70)

coverageMinimumPerFile.title: Test command of documentation coverage per file with a minimum (default 0)

coverageTestThresholdFail.title: Test command of documentation coverage (global or per file) will fail with error or just warn user (true: error, false: warn)

disableSourceCode.title: Do not add source code tab and links to source code

disableDomTree.title: Do not add dom tree tab

disableGraph.title: Do not add the dependency graph

disableCoverage.title: Do not add the documentation coverage report

disablePrivate.title: Do not show private in generated documentation

disableProtected.title: Do not show protected in generated documentation

disableInternal.title: Do not show @internal in generated documentation

disableLifeCycleHooks.title: Do not show Angular lifecycle hooks in generated documentation

disableConstructors.title: Do not show constructors in generated documentation

disableRoutesGraph.title: Do not add the routes graph

disableSearch.title: Do not add the search input

disableDependencies.title: Do not add the dependencies list

disableDependenciesTab.title: Do not add the per-component Dependencies tab (standalone import graph)

disablePlaygroundTab.title: Do not add the Playground tab even when @playground blocks are present

playgroundDependencies.title: Extra npm dependencies to inject into every @playground StackBlitz manifest. Wins over the consumer-package.json auto-forward. Use for libraries the consumer ships but doesn't npm install directly, or to pin a specific version per build.

playgroundMaterialShell.title: Force the Material app shell (Roboto + Material-Icons font links and the mat-typography / mat-app-background body classes) into every @playground index.html, independent of Material auto-detect. Use for component libraries themed to look like Material via a Sass theme bridge. Does not add @angular/material or @angular/cdk.

playgroundDepDepth.title: Max import depth followed when walking a @playground's dependency graph. Default 3.

playgroundFileCountCap.title: Hard ceiling on the number of source files in one @playground manifest. Exceeding it fails that playground with a message naming the walked files. Default 25.

playgroundFileCap.title: Per-file character cap before a bundled @playground source is truncated with a footer. Default 8000.

playgroundHead.title: Arbitrary <head> entries injected into every @playground index.html (after the Material shell links, when present) — for custom fonts, meta tags, CSP, or preloads. Emitted verbatim.

playgroundGlobalStyles.title: Global CSS appended to every @playground src/styles.css, after the default body reset — for fonts, resets, or any global rules the examples depend on.

playgroundVendor.title: Package names and/or globs (e.g. @scope/*) to vendor into @playground projects from the locally built dist/ instead of the npm registry. The matched package and its transitive closure are embedded and wired as file: dependencies, so the playground runs against the working tree, not the last published release.

playgroundVendorRoot.title: Base directory the playgroundVendor closure is read from. Each matched package is located by its package.json name, anywhere under this root. Defaults to dist.

playgroundVendorCap.title: Backstop byte cap on a single playground's slimmed-and-pruned vendored closure. Defaults to 1500000, set under StackBlitz's ~2MB project-POST limit so an oversized closure fails the build instead of producing a manifest that 413s on launch.

playgroundVendorIncludeSourcemaps.title: Keep *.map sourcemaps in vendored packages. Off by default — sourcemaps are a large slice of FESM byte size and the WebContainer build never reads them.

strictPlaygrounds.title: Fail the build when a non-vendored @playground imports a subpath or named symbol absent from the version of the package pinned in node_modules. Default false (warn only).

disableProperties.title: Do not add the properties list

showEffects.title: Show Angular effect() entries in a dedicated Effects block

disableFilePath.title: Do not add the file path

disableOverview.title: Do not add the overview page

minimal.title: Minimal mode with only documentation. No search, no graph, no coverage.

shikiTheme.title: Shiki syntax highlighting theme pair (e.g. 'github-light:github-dark' or 'nord')

host.title: Change default host address for serving

stackblitzTemplate.title: StackBlitz project template ID for examples

menuLayout.title: Sidebar layout (config-only, no CLI flag). 'feature' (default) lists the entry points and their features with the primary members of each, the full surface on references.html; 'type' keeps one chapter per Angular artefact kind, grouped by feature

features.title: Feature keys by file glob (config-only). Keys are globs over file paths relative to the working directory, values a feature key (one segment, lower case, digits and dashes) relative to the file's entry point or app root. The first matching glob in object order wins; it never moves a symbol into another entry point. Overrides @feature tags and the detected features.

featureContainers.title: App folders whose sub-folders are the features (config-only): src/app/features/admin gives the feature 'admin'.

featureUtilityFolders.title: Folders below an entry point that belong to its root feature instead of forming a feature of their own (config-only).

featuresName.title: Label for the Features chapter in menuLayout: 'feature' (config-only). Defaults to the translated 'features' i18n key.

referencesName.title: Label for the References chapter in menuLayout: 'feature' (config-only). Defaults to the translated 'references' i18n key.

collapsedAll.title: Force every sidebar chapter AND every nested folder group to start collapsed on first load (config-only). Overrides toggleMenuItems and the default expansion of the first two group levels.

publicApiOnly.title: Document only symbols exported from index.d.ts files in the specified dist folder

maxSearchResults.title: Max search results on the results page. Set to 0 for unlimited
